text:
Ice Boom - Installation - Montréal to Trois-Rivières - Lanoraie
Lanoraie ice boom installation taking place from 1100 UTC until 2100 UTC beginning 28 Oct 2026. Tugs and barges on site. 
Minimum wake requested for upbound vessels.
